notes:
Summary: mid-market product org building an in-app onboarding copilot (guided flows + step completion). Evaluating Hosted API first (fast experiment), then Dedicated if latency/cost profile requires it. POC: 2-week sandbox focusing on 3 high-traffic flows (signup guidance, feature discovery, billing help).

Key quotes / seller notes:
- 'Need very consistent perceived latency for short turns — streaming is required for UX.'
- 'Token spend is our biggest fear; want hard caps + graceful fallbacks.'

Performance targets / requirements:
- Latency SLO: p50 <= 100ms for small completions (50-150 tokens), p95 <= 300ms (goal). Streaming to first-token <120ms perceived.
- Throughput: bursts to 200 concurrent users during onboarding surges; typical steady-state ~30 qps.
- Cost controls: token caps per session + model routing to cheaper variants for non-critical prompts. Estimated avg token per session target 300-700 tokens.

POC scope / technical asks:
- Demo request: streaming + tool calling (user lookup, feature flag toggle) and structured output for guided steps.
- Need sample SDK integration (React) and a short example of function/tool calling security model.
- Willing to test Hosted API with sampling of 3 model families; long-term interest in Dedicated if we can hit p95 and cost windows.

Security / compliance notes:
- SOC2 required for procurement; ISO27001 preferred.
- Must support SSO (SAML/Okta) and KMS for keying production secrets.
- Data residency: EU customer data must remain in eu-region for certain customers.

Recent timeline (short bullets):
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (AE Maya) — high level product + onboarding use-case (Fireflies FF-20260218).
- 2026-02-28: Technical scoping with SE (Ravi) — discussed streaming UX, tool calling patterns, token caps; requested POC template (drive link).

- 2026-03-04: Security FAQ sent; asked for SOC2 report and KMS integration doc (drive link).
- 2026-03-08: Internal procurement flagged DPA/legal questions — paused formal quote.

Next steps (explicit):
- (ASAP) Redwood to provide a Hosted API POC kit: React sample, token-cap example + telemetry hooks.
- (By 2026-03-20) Schedule Dedicated pricing deep-dive if Hosted POC latency falls short.
- Legal: Redwood legal to provide DPA + SOC2 artifacts; security deep-dive w/ portalflare infra team.

Short-term blockers: procurement timeline (quarter-end), legal sign-off on DPA, confirmation on egress/residency for EU customers.
